title: Ginsenoside Rg1 alleviates PCPA-induced insomnia by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis through the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway in mice.
authors: Li, Jingyi; Wang, Xiufeng; Zhang, Yu; Wei, Min; Qi, Jianqiang; Liu, Dan; Wu, Runhua; Chen, Qin; Huang, Junshan
one_liner_zh: 研究人参皂苷Rg1通过Nrf2/HO-1通路抑制NLRP3炎症小体改善失眠，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aims to investigate the neuroprotective effects of Ginsenoside Rg1 in alleviating P-chlorophenylalanine (PCPA)-induced insomnia and explore its underlying mechanisms involving the inhibition of NOD-Like Receptor Family Pyrin Domain Containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome activation and pyroptosis through the Nuclear Factor Erythroid 2-Related Factor 2 (Nrf2)/Heme Oxygenase-1 (HO-1) pathway in mice. METHODS: Sprague-Dawley rats were randomly divided into five groups: control, sleep deprivation (SD, PCPA-induced insomnia), and three treatment groups receiving different doses of Ginsenoside Rg1 (low, medium, and high). Behavioral assessments included the Pentobarbital Sodium-Induced Sleep Test (PIST), Sucrose Preference Test (SPT), and Morris Water Maze (MWM). Histopathological and immunofluorescence evaluations of hippocampal tissues were performed. Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA) was used to measure neurotransmitter levels (5-Hydroxytryptamine [5-HT], 5-Hydroxytryptophan [5-HTP], Gamma-aminobutyric acid [GABA], glutamate [GLU]) and pro-inflammatory cytokines (Tumor Necrosis Factor Alpha [TNF-alpha], Interleukin-6 [IL-6], Interleukin-1 beta [IL-1beta], Interleukin-8 [IL-8]). In vitro, corticosterone-induced neurotoxicity in HT22 hippocampal cells was assessed, and the role of the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway was examined through molecular docking, gene silencing, and Western blot. RESULTS: Ginsenoside Rg1 treatment significantly improved PCPA-induced insomnia symptoms in a dose-dependent manner, as evidenced by reduced sleep latency, increased sleep duration, restored sucrose preference, and improved spatial memory. Histopathological analysis revealed that Ginsenoside Rg1 mitigated neuronal damage and astrocytic activation. Neurotransmitter imbalances were corrected, and inflammation was alleviated, as reflected by reductions in pro-inflammatory cytokines and increased interleukin-10 (IL-10) levels. Mechanistically, Ginsenoside Rg1 inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome activation, pyroptosis, and reduced IL-1beta and IL-8 levels in both in vivo and in vitro models. The activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway was further confirmed by molecular docking, immunofluorescence, and Western blot, demonstrating that Nrf2 activation was critical for the anti-inflammatory effects of Ginsenoside Rg1. CONCLUSION: Ginsenoside Rg1 effectively alleviates PCPA-induced insomnia by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis, with its neuroprotective effects mediated through the activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway. These findings suggest Ginsenoside Rg1 as a potential therapeutic agent for insomnia and related neuroinflammatory conditions.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨人参皂苷Rg1在缓解PCPA（P-chlorophenylalanine，对氯苯丙氨酸）诱导失眠中的神经保护作用，并探索其潜在机制，即通过Nrf2（Nuclear Factor Erythroid 2-Related Factor 2，核因子E2相关因子2）/HO-1（Heme Oxygenase-1，血红素加氧酶-1）通路抑制NLRP3（NOD-Like Receptor Family Pyrin Domain Containing 3，NOD样受体家族含吡啶结构域蛋白3）炎症小体激活和细胞焦亡在小鼠中的作用。方法：Sprague-Dawley大鼠随机分为五组：对照组、睡眠剥夺组（SD，PCPA诱导失眠）和三个不同剂量的人参皂苷Rg1治疗组（低、中、高剂量）。行为学评估包括戊巴比妥钠诱导睡眠试验（PIST）、蔗糖偏好试验（SPT）和Morris水迷宫（MWM）。对海马组织进行了组织病理学和免疫荧光评估。使用酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）测量神经递质水平（5-羟色胺[5-HT]、5-羟色氨酸[5-HTP]、γ-氨基丁酸[GABA]、谷氨酸[GLU]）和促炎细胞因子（肿瘤坏死因子α[TNF-alpha]、白细胞介素-6[IL-6]、白细胞介素-1β[IL-1beta]、白细胞介素-8[IL-8]）。在体外，评估了皮质酮诱导的HT22海马细胞神经毒性，并通过分子对接、基因沉默和Western blot检查了Nrf2/HO-1通路的作用。结果：人参皂苷Rg1治疗以剂量依赖性方式显著改善了PCPA诱导的失眠症状，表现为睡眠潜伏期缩短、睡眠持续时间增加、蔗糖偏好恢复和空间记忆改善。组织病理学分析显示，人参皂苷Rg1减轻了神经元损伤和星形胶质细胞激活。神经递质失衡得到纠正，炎症得到缓解，表现为促炎细胞因子减少和白细胞介素-10（IL-10）水平升高。在机制上，人参皂苷Rg1在体内和体外模型中均抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活、细胞焦亡，并降低了IL-1β和IL-8水平。Nrf2/HO-1通路的激活通过分子对接、免疫荧光和Western blot进一步确认，表明Nrf2激活对人参皂苷Rg1的抗炎作用至关重要。结论：人参皂苷Rg1通过抑制NLRP3炎症小体激活和细胞焦亡有效缓解PCPA诱导的失眠，其神经保护作用通过激活Nrf2/HO-1通路介导。这些发现表明人参皂苷Rg1是治疗失眠及相关神经炎症疾病的潜在治疗药物。
